title: Samadhi Pada
summary: The first chapter of Patanjali's Yoga Sutras defines yoga and describes the nature of Samadhi, the state of meditative absorption.

verses.translation: Now, the instruction of Yoga begins.
verses.meaning: atha - now; yoga - union; anushasanam - instruction/discipline

verses.translation: Yoga is the inhibition of the modifications of the mind.
verses.meaning: yoga - yoga; chitta - mind; vritti - modifications; nirodhah - restraint
